content: 2. Spareseness of KB. A main issue of all PR methods like C-PR is the connectivity of the KB graph. If there is no path connecting INLINEFORM0 and INLINEFORM1 in the graph, path enumeration of C-PR gets stuck and inference becomes infeasible. In such cases, LiLi uses a template relation (“@-?-@") as the missing link marker to connect entity-pairs and continues feature extraction. A path containing “@-?-@" is called an incomplete path. Thus, the extracted feature set contains both complete (no missing link) and incomplete paths. Next, LiLi selects an incomplete path from the feature set and asks the user to provide a link for path completion. We refer to such a query as missing link query (MLQ).
